feed.emptyHint: Updates about your bookings, payments and showtimes will show up here.

BOOKING_CREATED.title: Booking created
BOOKING_CREATED.body: We received your booking for "{{movie}}" — booking code {{bookingCode}}.

PAYMENT_SUCCESS.title: Payment successful
PAYMENT_SUCCESS.body: Your payment for "{{movie}}" was successful. Booking {{bookingCode}} is confirmed.

PAYMENT_FAILED.title: Payment failed
PAYMENT_FAILED.body: Your payment for booking {{bookingCode}} did not go through. Please try again.

TICKET_ISSUED.title: Ticket issued
TICKET_ISSUED.body: Your ticket for "{{movie}}" is ready. Seats {{seats}} — booking {{bookingCode}}.

BOOKING_CANCELLED.title: Booking cancelled
BOOKING_CANCELLED.body: Your booking {{bookingCode}} for "{{movie}}" has been cancelled.

REFUND_COMPLETED.title: Refund completed
REFUND_COMPLETED.body: Your refund of {{amount}}đ for booking {{bookingCode}} has been completed.

SHOWTIME_CANCELLED.title: Showtime cancelled
SHOWTIME_CANCELLED.body: The showtime for "{{movie}}" at {{branch}} has been cancelled. Booking {{bookingCode}}.

SHOWTIME_CHANGED.title: Showtime changed
SHOWTIME_CHANGED.body: The showtime for "{{movie}}" (booking {{bookingCode}}) has changed. Please review your booking.
